checkpoint.purpose: Row-level diagnostic table (1,383 confirmed-benchmark cases) for SKU gate A full_spec_notice v8 (freeze c917a412...): Rakuten SKU keys, SKU price and source line, availability (reported only), fixed AU product and adopted/closest row with stock (reported only), per-requirement and AU-only judgments with quoted evidence spans, adopt/exclude decision with reason codes and notices, Luna label kept as matched/unmatched/review, outcome and risk category.
checkpoint.extract_at: repository root; preserve .lab-output relative paths; use unzip -n
checkpoint.label_derived_content: Every row carries the Luna v3 machine label (decision, matching AU row keys, rationale); not human-verified, not independent gold. Raw labels.jsonl is not included.
